capture.setup: docker run --name fxlab-d-redis1 --hostname redis-primary redis:7.4 (7 keys in db0, 2 keys in db3); fxlab-d-redis2 --hostname redis-replica redis:7.4 redis-server --replicaof fxlab-d-redis1 6379.
capture.command: Recording TCP proxy (lab-only Go program inside apps/collectors, removed after capture) between the OpenMap database collector's real prober (Collector.Collect from the Windows host, engine option set, port = proxy) and the container's 127.0.0.1-published port; every byte each side sent is stored in order, one file per TCP connection, with wire.json indexing the direction, offset and length of each contiguous segment. Target 127.0.0.1:56381 (redis-replica), no auth.

files.name: wire.json
files.description: Index of the recorded conversation: per connection, ordered client/server segments (offset, length) into the .bin file

files.name: wire/conn-1.bin
files.description: Raw TCP bytes of connection 1 exactly as exchanged (client and server segments concatenated in order)
